info.title: GitHub REST API (subset for PROOF corpus — OAS 3.1.x)
info.description: Extracted subset of github/rest-api-description v2.1.0 for PROOF benchmark corpus. See corpus/SOURCES.md for provenance.

get.description: The `parent` and `source` objects are present when the repository is a fork. `parent` is the repository this repository was forked from, `source` is the ultimate source for the network.

delete.description:
Deleting a repository requires admin access. If OAuth is used, the `delete_repo` scope is required.

If an organization owner has configured the organization to prevent members from deleting organization-owned
repositories, you will get a `403 Forbidden` response.

403.description: If an organization owner has configured the organization to prevent members from deleting organization-owned repositories, a member will get this response:

get.description: Lists all secrets available in an organization without revealing their encrypted values. You must authenticate using an access token with the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. GitHub Apps must have the `secrets` organization permission to use this endpoint.

post.summary: Create a self-hosted runner group for an enterprise
post.description:
Creates a new self-hosted runner group for an enterprise.

You must authenticate using an access token with the `manage_runners:enterprise` scope to use this endpoint.

visibility.description: Visibility of a runner group. You can select all organizations or select individual organization.

selected_organization_ids.description: List of organization IDs that can access the runner group.

runners.description: List of runner IDs to add to the runner group.

allows_public_repositories.description: Whether the runner group can be used by `public` repositories.

restricted_to_workflows.description: If `true`, the runner group will be restricted to running only the workflows specified in the `selected_workflows` array.

selected_workflows.description: List of workflows the runner group should be allowed to run. This setting will be ignored unless `restricted_to_workflows` is set to `true`.

items.description: Name of workflow the runner group should be allowed to run. Note that a ref, tag, or long SHA is required.

enterprise.description: The slug version of the enterprise name. You can also substitute this value with the enterprise id.

per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100).

repo.description: The name of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

size.description: The size of the repository. Size is calculated hourly. When a repository is initially created, the size is 0.

disabled.description: Returns whether or not this repository disabled.

squash_merge_commit_title.description:
The default value for a squash merge commit title:

- `PR_TITLE` - default to the pull request's title.
- `COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE` - default to the commit's title (if only one commit) or the pull request's title (when more than one commit).

squash_merge_commit_message.description:
The default value for a squash merge commit message:

- `PR_BODY` - default to the pull request's body.
- `COMMIT_MESSAGES` - default to the branch's commit messages.
- `BLANK` - default to a blank commit message.

merge_commit_title.description:
The default value for a merge commit title.

  - `PR_TITLE` - default to the pull request's title.
  - `MERGE_MESSAGE` - default to the classic title for a merge message (e.g., Merge pull request #123 from branch-name).

merge_commit_message.description:
The default value for a merge commit message.

- `PR_TITLE` - default to the pull request's title.
- `PR_BODY` - default to the pull request's body.
- `BLANK` - default to a blank commit message.
